configuration.configuration: LUNAR-PCS-01, ACR1-calibrated imposed release and custody timing on a declared finite lunar host
configuration.core_inertia_scope: Declared positive-definite complete280kg retained-core surrogate. Actual ACR1 slot/release coordinates are reused; this is not a measured host mass-property model.
configuration.main_thrust_line: Body+X through instantaneous retained-host CG, requiring an allocated host thrust couple or offset compensation; no provider capability asserted.
configuration.hold_torque_bound_method: Quintic payload+cradle transport envelope using7.573043kg source mass,0.25m feed and0.784m lift, actual slot lever arms. Full contact/control implementation remains a hardware gate.
configuration.mission_success: All12 releases at assigned450s slots,6prograde/6retrograde,1–3m/s calibrated commands,400s zero-force load coast and guards, finite torque/rate/thrust, >=8kg remaining independent disposal allocation, each released osculating perilune>20km. These are declared investigation criteria,not customer requirements.

search.objective: Minimize accumulated bounded preparation/recovery time, then propellant proxy; exhaustive choices overremainingcell,signandroll with6/6 sign counts, beam-pruned, not global optimum.

limits: Imposed post-arrest point-release mapping reuses the accepted1D coupled source; finite pulse/contact6DOF and source qualification on this lunar host are not established.
Piecewise finite attitude control uses full inertia/quaternion/angular-momentum dynamics and consumes declared cold-gas propellant; it is not real provider authority.
Internal transport hold demand is a bounded kinematic envelope,not a native multibody/contact replay; physical fault/custody validation remains external.
Campaign targets are separation-energy classes and useful bound-orbit floors,not actual customer full-state/time requirements.
Nominal Python campaign uses lunar point gravity. Native identical-force and harmonics/third-body replay are separately identified.
All sphere/clearance criteria omit terrain,coverage,communications,conjunction and disposal policy approval.
